compliance.summary: All compliance requirements verified against spec.md — implementation is fully compliant.

config_changed.notes: EVENT_SCHEMAS lists 5 caller fields (user_id, config_key, old_value, new_value, user_agent); system fields (event_type, log_id, timestamp, signature) auto-generated. old_value exempt from non-empty check per planner1 design.

user_login.notes: success typed as bool in EVENT_SCHEMAS; ip_address extracted from request.remote_addr in app.py.

report_accessed.notes: All 4 caller fields validated as non-empty strings.

data_exported.notes: record_count typed as int in EVENT_SCHEMAS.

payment_initiated.notes: amount typed as float in EVENT_SCHEMAS.

details.canonical_json: Correctly implemented: excludes 'signature', sorts keys alphabetically, compact separators (',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False.
details.hmac_algorithm: HMAC-SHA256 via hmac.new(key, canonical.encode('utf-8'), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest() — correct.
details.key_management: AUDIT_HMAC_KEY env var with 'default-key' fallback, encoded as UTF-8 bytes.
details.signature_attachment: Computed and attached to every entry returned by log_event().
details.system_field_protection: log_id and signature are in SYSTEM_FIELDS and rejected if passed by caller. timestamp callable (not in SYSTEM_FIELDS) allows testability.

details.verify_log_algorithm: Iterates entries; marks tampered if signature missing; recomputes expected signature via _compute_signature(); compares with hmac.compare_digest() for timing safety.
details.corrupted_signature_detection: Correctly flags entries where signature does not match recomputed value.
details.test_coverage: 20/20 tests passing, including: empty log → [], valid entries → [], tampered entry detected at correct index, missing signature detected.

details.safe_wrapper: _safe_audit_log() uses try/except — audit failures log to stderr but never block responses.
details.route_preservation: Route signatures and return structures unchanged per spec.
details.system_fields_delegated: log_id, timestamp, signature NOT passed by app.py; all auto-generated by audit.log_event().

details.rotation_strategy: Daily rotation: audit_today.jsonl for current day, renamed to audit_YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl at midnight.
details.file_persistence: JSONL format with fsync after each write; threading.Lock for thread safety.
details.retention: 7 years (2555 days) per policy — rotation naming supports retention management.

details.event_type: Present on all entries, validated against VALID_EVENT_TYPES set.
details.log_id: UUID4 string, unique per entry, auto-generated by log_event().
details.timestamp: ISO 8601 UTC format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ), auto-generated if not supplied by caller.

observations.detail: No explicit isinstance type validation for fields (e.g., success as bool, record_count as int, amount as float) — non-string types pass through without type check. Spec does not mandate type enforcement; this does not affect compliance.

Extra/unknown caller fields are merged into the entry without rejection. Spec does not explicitly forbid extra fields; signature computation includes all fields present so tamper detection is not compromised.

Negative test coverage (invalid event_type, missing fields, wrong types, system field rejection, empty string rejection) is limited in the current 20-test suite. Implementation-level validation exists but is not exercised by tests.

security.summary: HMAC-SHA256 签名与验证全部通过安全审查。SEC-001（verify_log TypeError 崩溃）已由 executor2 在 audit.py line 361-365 通过 isinstance(stored_sig, str) 类型检查修复，verify_log 现在对所有非字符串 signature（None/int/dict/list/bool）均优雅标记为 tampered 而非崩溃。核心 HMAC 算法、规范化 JSON、常量时间比较、线程安全、Unicode 处理均验证通过。仍有 2 个中/低风险建议：额外字段注入（日志污染）和弱默认密钥。

findings.title: verify_log() — 非字符串 signature 导致 TypeError 崩溃
findings.description: 【已修复】原问题：当 entry['signature'] 为非字符串时 hmac.compare_digest() 抛出 TypeError。修复：在 line 363 添加 isinstance(stored_sig, str) 类型检查，非字符串类型直接标记为 tampered 并 continue，不再进入 compare_digest 比较。覆盖所有攻击场景：None、int、bool、list、dict。
findings.attack_scenario: 攻击者构造 signature: null 的日志条目 → 现在被 isinstance 检查捕获，标记为 tampered，不再崩溃。
findings.fix_applied: executor2 在 fix_sec001 任务中添加: if not isinstance(stored_sig, str): tampered.append(i); continue
findings.reverification: verifier2 确认修复覆盖 None / 42 / True / [] / {} / '' / 正常hex 全场景，全部正确处理。
findings.spec_reference: spec.md: verify_log() must correctly detect entries whose signature field has been corrupted or is missing

findings.title: 额外字段注入 — 日志污染
findings.description: log_event() 在合并调用者字段时不过滤不在 EVENT_SCHEMAS 中的额外字段，允许注入任意键值对到审计日志。额外字段被签名覆盖不会绕过篡改检测，但会污染日志内容。
findings.attack_scenario: 恶意或错误的调用者可注入 {'__admin_bypass': true} 等任意字段，污染日志并可能误导下游审计工具。
findings.fix: 在 entry.update(fields) 前过滤: fields = {k: v for k, v in fields.items() if k in schema}

findings.title: 弱默认 HMAC 密钥
findings.description: AUDIT_HMAC_KEY 未设置时回退到硬编码 'default-key'。符合 spec 要求但生产环境存在安全风险。
findings.attack_scenario: 生产环境若忘记设置环境变量，所有签名使用公开已知的默认密钥，攻击者可伪造签名使篡改检测失效。
findings.fix: 生产启动时若密钥为 'default-key' 应发出安全警告。
